text: Day 4 Of India AI Impact Summit 2026: PM Modi's Address To Macron As Key Speaker | What's Lined Up?Prime Minister Narendra Modi will inaugurate Day 4 of the AI Impact Summit 2026 at 9:40 AM and address the leaders' session. At 11:00 AM, he will join world leaders for an expo walkthrough, visiting country pavilions showcasing AI innovations. At 12:00 PM, discussions will be held on AI governance, infrastructure and global cooperation. At 5:30 PM, the Prime Minister will participate in a CEO roundtable.
